# Jungle Rent

> Real estate startup with dual mission: solving the student housing crisis and democratizing access to real estate investment in Turin, Italy.

## About

Jungle Rent S.r.l. is a certified **Start-up Innovativa** founded in October 2025. We acquire, renovate, and manage properties to rent to university students and tourists in Turin, serving 90,000+ students across 7 major institutions. Investment opportunities start from €100.

## Priority URLs

- [Home](https://junglerent.it): Main landing page with investment and housing info
- [Investors](https://junglerent.it/investitori): Investment opportunities from €100
- [Sell Your Property](https://junglerent.it/vendi): Sell directly to Jungle Rent - zero fees, 60-90 days closing
- [Property Valuation](https://junglerent.it/valutazione-immobile): FREE property valuation tool (OMI data 2025)
- [Blog](https://junglerent.it/blog): 29+ bilingual guides on Turin living and investment
- [About](https://junglerent.it/chi-siamo): Company information and team

## Services

1. **Student Housing Management** - Professional property management for student rentals near Politecnico and UniTo
2. **Real Estate Investment** - Accessible investment from €100 in Turin's university housing market
3. **Property Acquisition** - Strategic purchases in San Salvario, Crocetta, Vanchiglia, Centro, Aurora, Lingotto
4. **Short-Term Rental Management** - Airbnb and Booking.com optimization

## Target Markets

- **Investors**: Real estate investment from €100 with professional management
- **Students**: Quality housing near Turin universities (90,000+ students)
- **Property Owners**: Professional management services

## Key Statistics (December 2025)

- Student Room Rent: €350-550/month (San Salvario, Cenisia, Vanchiglia)
- Crocetta Premium: €500-700/month
- GTT Under 26 Pass: €25/month or €258/year
- Universities: Politecnico di Torino, UniTo, ESCP, SAA, IED, IAAD, IUSTO
